string.text: Activates your career ability during a battle once its energy bar is full. Defaults to V.
Applies the higher TAOM fast-forward multiplier. Defaults to E, which is also Rotate Camera Right; rebind either one to stop them firing together.
Applies the TAOM fast-forward speed multiplier. Shares a key with the vanilla pause toggle by default, which is deliberate.
Hold Ctrl together with this key for the highest TAOM speed multiplier. Releasing either key restores the previous speed.
